impacts.text: every standards-compliant integrator will display that as `1,000,000 sUSDM` instead of `1 sUSDM`
Off-chain systems that derive price-per-share or TVL from `totalSupply()` and `decimals()` will misprice `sUSDM`.
If `sUSDM` is ever listed in another DeFi protocol, the wrong decimals can lead to catastrophic collateral or swap normalization mistakes.
